subject: ICT
title: Let's Play with Colours
subtitle: No same colour side by side
hero_picture: Two Kerala girls playing a board game on the floor, a colourful square board with triangles between them, a cat watching.

sections.heading: A colourful game
text: Two friends are playing a board game.
sections.caption: Playing a board game
sections.picture: Two girls playing a game on the floor with a colourful square board divided into coloured triangles.

sections.heading: Circles and lines
text: Look at these circles joined by lines.
There is one rule to follow.
sections.caption: Circles joined by lines
sections.picture: Five plain white circles on paper joined by straight lines like a bow-tie shape, waiting to be coloured.

sections.heading: The colour rule
text: Two circles joined by a line must not have the same colour.
If one is red, the next must be another colour.
sections.caption: Different colours for neighbours
sections.picture: Three crayons (red, blue, green) beside a drawing of circles joined by lines, two joined circles coloured red and blue.

sections.heading: Graph colouring game
text: Click on a circle to choose its colour.
Don't give the same colour next to each other.
sections.caption: Colouring on the screen
sections.picture: A laptop screen showing circles joined by lines over a park scene, the circles coloured so that no two joined circles share a colour.

sections.heading: Colour a map
text: Draw shapes that touch each other.
sections.caption: Colouring touching shapes
sections.picture: A girl colouring a map-like drawing of shapes with crayons, each neighbouring shape in a different colour.

rhyme: Red and blue and green and gold,
Follow the rule that we were told,
Side by side, not the same,
activity: Draw 4 circles in a ring, each joined to the next. Colour them with only 2 colours, following the rule.
talk: What is the rule in this game?
If one circle is red, can the joined circle be red?
summary: When circles are joined by a line, we colour them with different colours.

questions.prompt: Two circles joined by a line should be...
questions.explanation: Joined circles must have different colours.

questions.prompt: A circle is red. The joined circle can be...
questions.explanation: It must be a different colour, like blue.

questions.prompt: In a board game, we play by...
What do we click to choose a colour for a circle?
questions.explanation: Click on a circle to colour it.
